name: Choose a color and retain a demo bag
description: Verifies that a selected color is added, survives reload and can be removed.
steps: Use Explore headphones to reach the collection
Select Cobalt in the product dialog
Verify SOVA ONE Cobalt is present
expected: The chosen Cobalt color survives reload. After removal it stays absent, the count is zero and the empty bag offers Continue exploring.

name: View all ten original images and download one PNG
description: Verifies the campaign contains ten individual files and supports full image viewing and original download.
steps: Scroll to A closer look and verify the full detail photograph, including the SOVA name and CLOSER TO THE MUSIC. text, is visible without cropping
Verify ten View photo buttons are available
Use Previous to return to photo 01
expected: The counter advances and returns correctly, a valid original PNG downloads, and closing returns to the campaign gallery. The detail photograph retains its original portrait proportions and its full text is readable.

name: Use mobile navigation and retain Spanish preference
description: Verifies mobile controls work and Spanish text remains after refresh.
steps: Open the Marfil product and close it
Scroll to the detail photograph and verify the complete original, including SOVA and CLOSER TO THE MUSIC., is visible without cut-off letters
Open Menú and select La campaña
Inspect the Consultar sobre este diseño link
expected: Navigation closes after selection, Spanish is retained after refresh, the product dialog fits the phone, FAQ explains the demo, and the inquiry link points to https://thelaunchera.com/. There is no horizontal page overflow. The detail photograph fits the phone width at its natural portrait proportions, with no clipping of its printed headline.

name: Keep the empty bag and concept boundary clear
description: Verifies the demo never presents an empty selection as an order or payment.
steps: If the bag contains items, remove each listed item
expected: The empty bag shows a clear empty message and no payment or order action. Continue exploring returns to the collection. The footer identifies a fictional brand demo with no orders or payments.
